## Public documentation change

Describe the purpose and affected public pages. Do not include private evidence, credentials, wallet details, unpublished code or vulnerability findings.

## Review checks

- [ ] Documentation-only scope and rights to share the material.
- [ ] No personal identity, private source, secrets, signing details, internal paths or sensitive attachments.
- [ ] Claims accurately distinguish design objectives, fictional examples and verified results.
- [ ] Affected links and headings checked.
- [ ] Existing security and contribution boundaries preserved.
- [ ] Maintainer approval required before merge.

If a check cannot be completed, explain the non-sensitive blocker. Security findings must use a confirmed confidential route, not this public PR. No changes to access, authentication, security settings or private systems are authorised by this template.
